findings.title: Stripe secret key (Anvil demo key) is shipped to every browser
findings.why: Anyone who opens DevTools on your site can copy this Stripe secret key (Anvil demo key) and use it as you.
findings.fix: Roll the key in the Stripe dashboard now (treat it as leaked). Move every call that needs it to a server route that reads it from an environment variable; only the publishable key (pk_live_) belongs in the browser.

findings.title: A member can read /api/settings (Member cannot read workspace settings)
findings.why: Your rule says a member must not read this, but the server answered with data. Hiding a page in the menu is not protection; anyone can send this request.
findings.fix: In the handler for /api/settings, check the signed-in role on the server and answer 403 for member. Add a test that a member gets 403.

findings.title: /app/member/notes.html scrolls sideways on a phone (853px wide at 390px)
findings.why: The element table.notes-table is wider than the 390px screen, so the whole page slides left and right. On phones this is usually the first thing people notice.
findings.fix: Let table.notes-table shrink or wrap (max-width: 100%), or put it in a container with overflow-x: auto, or switch to a stacked layout below 640px.

findings.title: console.error on /app/admin/settings.html (as admin): settings: field "reply_to" is empty
findings.why: Errors in the console either mean something is broken or they hide real errors from you and your error tracker.
findings.fix: Fix the cause, or stop logging it as an error if it is expected.

findings.title: Images must have alternative text (image-alt, 1 on /app/guest/shared.html)
findings.why: People using a screen reader or keyboard cannot use this part of the page as intended (axe rule image-alt).
findings.fix: Add alt text that says what the image shows, or alt="" when it is only decoration.

humanChecks.prompt: Does a first-time visitor understand what the app is for and where to start?
steps: Open the app in a private window
Without clicking anything, say what the app does
Find the main button or link and follow it

humanChecks.prompt: Can a new person sign up, log out and log back in?
steps: Open the app in a private window
Create an account with a new email
Log out
Log back in with the same email

humanChecks.prompt: Does "forgot password" actually let someone back in?
steps: Log out
Use "forgot password" with a real inbox you control
Follow the email link and set a new password
Log in with the new password

humanChecks.prompt: With two accounts, is each person kept out of the other one's data?
steps: Create something private with account A
Log in as account B in another browser
Try to find or open A's item (lists, search, direct link)

humanChecks.prompt: Does checkout work end to end in test mode, and does the app know you paid?
steps: Switch payments to test mode
Buy the cheapest plan with a test card
Check the app shows the paid state
Check the payment shows up in the provider dashboard

humanChecks.prompt: When a payment fails, does the user see a clear message and stay on the free plan?
steps: Use a test card that is declined (e.g. 4000 0000 0000 0002 on Stripe)
Read the message
Check you did not get the paid features

humanChecks.prompt: Do forms explain mistakes and keep what you typed?
steps: Submit the main form empty
Fill it with one wrong field
Check each error says what to fix and your other input is still there

humanChecks.prompt: On your own phone, can you use the main pages without scrolling sideways?
steps: Open the app on a real phone
Visit the pages Anvil flagged
Try to read a full row and use the main buttons

humanChecks.prompt: Have you rotated (replaced) every leaked key Anvil found?
steps: Open each provider dashboard named in the report
Create a new key and delete the old one
Update your server environment and redeploy

humanChecks.prompt: Should a member be able to read /api/team? Anvil got 200 with 635 bytes; only pages of more trusted roles use it.
steps: Sign in as member
Open /api/team in the address bar (a GET request)
If you see data that this role should not see, answer Broken

notChecked.why: Only the current files (and what the browser downloaded) were scanned, not older commits.
No Supabase or Firebase config was found in the scanned code, so the read-only rules probe was skipped.
Anvil never makes real or test charges; payment findings come from static scans only.

notChecked.what: Load, performance under traffic and rate limits
notChecked.why: Out of scope: Anvil runs one browser, not a load test.

notChecked.what: Write actions (create, edit, delete) and anything behind a form
notChecked.why: Anvil only sends GET requests and never submits forms; the human checks cover these.

notChecked.what: Server-side code paths not reachable from the pages crawled
notChecked.why: Only pages linked from the start page (per role) and configured access rules were exercised.
Passing these checks does not make an app secure. Anvil reports what it checked and found, nothing more.
